item.dc:creator: Jay Carstens

item.title: Five hospitalised after forklift catches fire in Brisbane
item.description: A person has sustained life-threatening burns in a blaze at a commercial site in Brisbane's east. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Heavy metal but no tutus in new Macbeth ballet production
item.description: Making a ballet out of Shakespeare's 400-year-old play Macbeth gave choreographer Alice Topp the chance to create something entirely new. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emma Wynne and Jo Trilling

item.title: Shifting Ayrton Senna plaque a sign of things to come for Adelaide's MotoGP
item.description: While it signifies big changes for the famed Adelaide street circuit that has grown a global reputation for excellence since 1985, an industry stalwart considers proposed changes to accommodate the MotoGP a "transition" rather than the end of an era. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Malcolm Sutton

item.title: Bathla $3.4b in debt and facing work halting at some sites
item.description: Bathla Group owes known creditors about $3.4 billion, including $3.08 billion to secured lenders, according to preliminary figures presented at the company's first creditors' meeting. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lin Lin

item.title: Melbourne man jailed for four years for keeping woman as slave
item.description: Chee Kit Chong was found guilty of intentionally keeping a slave and assault over his treatment of an Indonesian woman aged in her 60s. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Jenkins

item.title: 'Supermodel' bull sells for $420k, smashing Australian record
item.description: The most expensive bull in Australian history has sold for the extraordinary price of $420,000, with both tears and champagne flowing after the emotional sale. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Amelia Bernasconi

item.title: Almost 200,000 people searched for weapons in Qld in the past year
item.description: Police Minister Dan Purdie said almost 1,400 weapons had been taken off the street since Jack's Law was made permanent last year. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: De Minaur crashes out of US Open in shock straight sets loss
item.description: Alex de Minaur has crashed out of the US Open at the second-round stage, beaten in straight sets by Botic van de Zandschulp. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: More than 100 motorbikes tear through outback pub in world record attempt
item.description: More than 100 motorcyclists have ridden through an Alice Springs pub in an attempt to set a world record as part of the town's rev-head event, Red CentreNATS. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Elsie Lange

item.title: Second rider dies after cyclists struck by car in Canberra last week
item.description: Police say a second cyclist who was left in a critical condition after a car "ploughed" into a group of riders last week has now died in hospital. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Death by a thousand cuts' as mining companies use planning 'loophole'
item.description: More than a dozen coalmine modifications have been approved by the NSW government since 2023, with critics saying the process is a "loophole" that allows companies to expand operations without proper oversight. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Peter Sanders

item.title: Hundreds miss out on stolen wages class action while lawyers cash in
item.description: Aboriginal organisations in north-east Arnhem Land say they have been left to deal with the aftermath of a stolen wages class action that failed to include hundreds of potentially eligible claimants. One Yolŋu elder says he only found out about the class action after others received payments. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Oliver Chaseling

item.title: Kyrgios free to compete after accepting one-month cocaine ban
item.description: Nick Kyrgios can return to tennis after a one-month suspension and entering a treatment program after testing positive for cocaine in June. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Traditional owners say national park can 'breathe again' after handback
item.description: A major tourist attraction in outback Queensland has been handed back to its traditional owners under a landmark agreement described as a long-awaited "homecoming". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tim Little

item.title: Brisbane man charged with alleged supply of gel blaster guns interstate
item.description: A 38-year-old Queensland man will face court today over the alleged distribution of gel blaster firearms to interstate customers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Americans urge caution as Australia braces for data centre boom
item.description: Americans urge Australians to ensure data centre companies are transparent and make sure policy helps us to make the most of foreign investment. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Bec Symons

item.title: Shire confirms five dogs poisoned on two streets, killing three
item.description: Carnarvon dog owners are being warned to remain vigilant after five pets are poisoned, resulting in three of them dying. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Hagan

item.title: US vice-president says Iran conflict not a war
item.description: Just days after the biggest escalation in hostilities in more than a month, US Vice-President JD Vance says he would not categorise the Iran conflict as a war. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australian wildcard stuns Italian star in US Open boilover
item.description: Australian wildcard Dane Sweeny has posted the biggest win of his career, upsetting dual grand slam semifinalist Lorenzo Musetti to make the US Open's last 32. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Fox makes golden return to Paris Olympic venue
item.description: Jess Fox has fond memories of the Vaires-sur-Marne Nautical Stadium, where she claimed a stunning double gold at the Paris Olympics. And upon her return to the venue for the ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup series, she claims yet another gold medal. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Simon Smale

item.title: Venue apologises for AI flyers that have 'no place' in creative industry
item.description: Chloe Young is facing an uphill battle amid a global AI boom, but some have accepted Young's offer to draw "squiggles" instead of using computer-generated flyers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Dan McCray

item.title: News live: Two more Australians confirmed safe in Nepal-Tibet floods; Hanson to make cost of living ‘worse’, union boss warns
item.description: This blog is now closed Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast ‘Gut-wrenching’: Bowen to meet with Nepali community today Chris Bowen said he would meet members of the Nepali Australian community later today. Every person who’s been rescued or found is a relief to their family and to the broader Australian community. But of course, we still have 36 Australians who are missing and unaccounted for, which is just gut-wrenching for all Australians and for the Nepalese Australian community in particular, whom I’m spending time with later today. But all I can say is that we’re… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Nick Visser

item.title: After his Broncos ending, a new beginning looms for Payne Haas
item.description: Payne Haas's final game for Brisbane was hardly a fitting occasion to end his legendary career with the club but it showed that even a player of his greatness can grapple with a premiership hangover. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nick Campton

item.title: Dockers wilt against masterful Hawthorn in qualifying final
item.description: Unbeaten at home all year and with a golden opportunity to close in on a maiden premiership, Fremantle must now do it the hard way after putting in — by some distance — its worst shift of the season against Hawthorn. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Greig Johnston

item.title: Victorian healthcare system is 'fundamentally broken', GP says
item.description: Australia's leading GP group warns people will continue to get sicker if clinics and staff are not supported. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jean Bell and Eden Hynninen

item.title: Live: ASX set to rise, ASIC fronts KPMG inquiry
item.description: Australian shares are set to rise after Wall Street rallied as US Treasury yields eased for the second straight session. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adelaide Miller and Lin Lin

item.title: Imran Khan's sons say former PM's health declining in prison
item.description: Imran Khan went from swashbuckling cricketer to Pakistan PM and then political prisoner. His sons now hold grave fears for their father's health. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adam Harvey
